blocks.text: Celebrity siblings Zia and Sixto have given their parents Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes another reason to be proud after showcasing their musical talents in their respective recital performances. The Kapuso couple’s children recently took the stage for their first performances of this kind. Zia demonstrated her singing skills at the RMA concert, while her younger brother Sixto played the drums at a separate gathering.
